title: Environmentalism

vibeProfile.oneLine: A concise global history of environmentalism across two centuries.

summary: Ramachandra Guha's concise global history of environmentalism traces the movement across two centuries and several continents, from early nature lovers and back-to-the-land thinkers to the ecological struggles of the poor in the global South. Clear, balanced and unusually attentive to non-Western environmentalism, it distinguishes the 'full-stomach' environmentalism of the rich world from the 'empty-belly' environmentalism of those fighting for survival. An accessible, authoritative introduction to how people everywhere came to defend the earth.
whyReadIt: Guha's clear, global history of the green movement, unusually fair to the environmentalism of the poor. Authoritative and readable.

funFacts.text: Guha distinguishes 'full-stomach' from 'empty-belly' environmentalism, a much-cited idea.
